Feature Suggestions & Bug Reports

Progeni is constantly expanding its suite of client-side web tools. If you have an idea for a utility that can save time without uploading files to a cloud server, let us know!

  • Bug Reports: Please mention your browser (Chrome/Safari/Firefox/Edge) and file format.
  • Tool Requests: Tell us the manual repetitive digital task you want automated.
  • Partnerships & Advertising: Email us with subject line [Partnership] Progeni.

We usually respond to all inquiries within 24 to 48 business hours.
